description: Add a shared File delivery section under Advanced settings on connection configuration forms, including SMTP. Reuse the existing capability snapshot endpoint and shared BO components. Determine applicable controls from capabilities, never provider-name branches. Cover all relevant settings from ../zaq-feat-channel-files: maximum file size, maximum encoded message size including body/headers/attachments, maximum attachments per message, and send message if files fail. Use consistent labels, help text, defaults, validation, and storage semantics across forms. Fixed transport limits appear read-only; configurable limits get inputs with known transport ceilings enforced. Required limits are marked required. Blank optional overrides use transport-provided limits; missing limits remain explicitly unconfigured, never unlimited. Display sizes in decimal MB (1 MB = 1000000 bytes), persist integer bytes, and show field-local errors. Save with the existing connection form, preserving unrelated settings; hide the section when no controls or limit information apply. Capability metadata must distinguish supported operations, fixed/configurable constraints, and required/optional configuration. Resolve this shared metadata contract before implementation and record any missing adapter declaration or dependency prerequisites; never invent capabilities or claim attachment sending is implemented to expose controls. Final stacked-PR objective: attachments can be sent through EmailBridge and JidoChatBridge to their adapters. Ownership: adapter capabilities plus selected channel configuration feed one shared TransportRequirements resolver; bridges must not independently define requirements or duplicate limit/policy rules. This issue implements BO settings, common normalization/validation, and capability plumbing needed for those settings; TransportRequirements resolution and attachment preparation/execution are separate issues. Action reuse assessment: inspect and extend existing capability endpoint, Engine connection settings APIs, ChannelConfig validation, ConnectorConfig helpers, and shared BO controls. Record concrete reuse/extend decisions and existing persistence paths before coding; all BO cross-service operations use NodeRouter and Zaq.Event. Follow AGENTS.md and applicable workflow, channels, BO design, testing, and configuration policies. Use TDD with original tests, not copied old-worktree tests: capability combinations including fallback and unsupported, fixed versus configurable limits, required versus optional values, unit conversions and invalid inputs, save/reload, preservation of unrelated settings, and equivalent behavior across generic channel and SMTP forms. Use property tests for numeric normalization and broad input invariants. Obtain required approval before changing existing test behavior or introducing architectural changes; follow the human UX/E2E gate where applicable. Keep issue 1 unchanged and build on issue 2 email capability alignment. Do not restart mix precommit without authorization; record validation status and remaining gates honestly.
title: [zaq-h2i.3] Add shared capability-driven file delivery settings in BO
